hardware_pages.notes: Book is 113 pages (Div 08 only). Two set blocks: (1) Section 08 17 13 Integrated Door Assemblies, 3.07 HARDWARE SCHEDULE, p24 = legend/intro only, sets #103 (p25) and #104 (p26). (2) Section 08 71 00, 3.06 HARDWARE SCHEDULE legend on p51, intro p52, sets p53 (#A1) through p113 (#111, 'END OF SECTION'). Sub-headings: 'Unit Hardware Sets (Typically Alphanumeric Set Numbers)' p53, 'Exterior Hardware Sets (Typically Two-Digit Set Numbers):' p57, 'Interior Hardware Sets (Typically Three-Digit Set Numbers):' p103. Detector FPs 20/33-48 are Part 2 product prose ('Where hardware groups/sets have different information...'), 24/52 are legend/intro pages without components. Missed pages 59/61/64/79 are set continuation pages, 78 is set #09.

header_pattern: For doors assigned Hardware Group/Set #103 on door schedule, provide the following:
For doors assigned hardware sets #28, #29 and #30 on door schedule, provide the following:
has_header_row: No per-set header row. A sample is given once in the intro: 'C. Hardware Columns - Example (Legend): Qty Device Description Device # (include specification language) Finish Manu' (p24, p52).
multi_page_sets: Yes: #01 p57-59, #02 p60-61, #03 p63-64, #09 p78-79, #10 p80-81, #19 p92-93 (table continues on next page without repeated header; continuation page starts mid-row e.g. p81 'frame to electrified ... reader locations').
set_level_lines: Header suffix notes: '#A1 – Entry Unit Doors', '#05 (see gate details on architectural drawings)', '#27 – final to be selected', '#106 – verify wide stile for 5” wide lockset'

Boxed notes inside the table: 'Note 1: In addition to the devices specified in hardware group/set below, coordinate for opening to be sound dampened; ...', 'Note 2: Furnish all devices & components for hardware groups/set above in accordance with Contract Documents ...'
'Note 2 - Description of Operation for hold-open: When door is placed in opened position, Magnetic Holder will automatically engage ...' (08 17 13 #103)
collision_examples: Mfr codes are 2-letter (IV, SC, PE, TR, LC, VO, BA, FR...), so 'PE' = Pemko as mfr per legend p51, and 'BL' (black anodized) appears in the FINISH column next to 'SE' (Select) - both 2-letter alpha; only column position distinguishes them. Many rows have no finish/mfr cells at all and instead name the manufacturer in prose ('202NDKB by NGP or approved equal', '209D by Pemko', '#679-05-HM by Schlage'). Also '4050.260 (3.75”) x Polished Chrome 260 BA' - finish 260 duplicated inside catalog.
quirks: Grid/table per set with long multi-line spec paragraphs in the catalog cell; product images/diagrams embedded inside cells (hinge sections, lever photo, threshold detail).

Vertical rotated margin watermark on every page ('Copyright © 2025 (please see Opening Consultants, Inc. confidentiality notice for further use of this document)' and '08 71 00 door hardware OCI r12-10-2025') whose tokens are interleaved into the text stream ('document) this of use further notice confidentiality Inc. Consultants, Opening see (please 2025 Copyright'). Also a print stamp 'PM 4:17:00 12/11/2025 printed Last' in 08 17 13.
Qty often blank placeholder: '__ Ea. Hinges 5BB1 (size & quantity per 08 71 00) 622 IV' / '_ Ea. Hinge'.

Header text varies: 'Hardware Group/Set #', 'Hardware Set/Group #', 'Hardware Groups/Set #', 'Hardware Group/Sets #', 'Hardware Groups/Sets #18', 'Hardware Group/Sets 102.1' (no #), multi-set headers '#B1 and #B2', 'hardware sets #28, #29 and #30', and sentence-style 'For doors assigned Hardware Group/Set #103 on door schedule, provide the following:'.
Set id collision across sections: #103 exists in 08 17 13 (p25, Syntegra integrated door) and in 08 71 00 (p103 region).
Rows that are coordination tasks rather than products ('Coordination task for security and/or electrical design...', 'QEL Power Supply Furnish and install #1) single gang power drop...').
Finish/mfr cells merged into catalog cell on many rows (seals, door bottoms, thresholds).
Page header 'OCI Design IFC 12.12.2025 The Commons Lane' (08 71 00) vs 'Steinberg Hart IFC The Commons Lane' (other sections); footer 'Door Hardware 08 71 00 - NN'.
notes_for_extractor: Hardest book of the group: table cells contain paragraph-length specs and images, qty is often a blank '__', mfr is a 2-letter code (PE/BL/SE ambiguity) or missing with the maker named in prose, and a rotated margin watermark injects junk tokens into every row. Sets span pages without repeated headers, header wording varies a lot (including multi-set headers and sentence-form headers), and set #103 is duplicated across two sections.
